Trusted by Microsoft, Tailwind & over a million websites
Learn how our dashboard works
Analytics for Huberman Lab are solely powered by Fathom. It's such a pleasure to use compared to Google Analytics. There's just the right number of features, and their platform is incredibly intuitive.
Ian Mackey, Huberman Lab I consider Fathom a must have tool if you want to understand what's happening with your website traffic. It's simple, speedy, and accurate.
Ruben Gamez, founder SignWell and Bidsketch For the longest time, website analytics software was seriously bad. It was hard to understand, time-consuming to use, and worse, it exploited visitor data for big tech to profit. We built Fathom to make analytics easy to use and respectful of privacy.
European analytics
Our entire company is built on putting digital privacy first. Your EU traffic is automatically routed through European-owned infrastructure , and as a Canadian company, we're covered by Canada's EU adequacy decision. Plus, we're GDPR, CCPA, ePrivacy, PECR (and more) compliant.
See more of your visitors
Plenty of analytics tools miss real people because of blockers, cookies and sampling. Fathom is built to show you human visits , so you get a clearer picture of who's on your site without invading anyone's privacy.
Our script is fast
Our lightweight script loads without holding up your page. It loads from all over the world, from the place closest to the person visiting your site. Learn how analytics affects page speed .
We sell software, not data
This is why we created anonymous pageview tracking that doesn't collect or store personal data (we have no use for it). Because of this, Fathom doesn't require annoying cookie notices.
See all our features Why choose Fathom? The best Google Analytics alternative with a focus on privacy.
See all of your sites at a glance
See every site on your account on a single screen with our all-sites view , including totals for things like current visitors and bounce rate.
Ads and newsletter campaigns
Use UTMs to see how your ad campaigns are doing and which links in your newsletter get clicked.
Measure your conversions
Measure the actions that matter to your business, from signups and downloads to purchases. Add custom events and attach a monetary value to see more than pageviews.
No cookie banners
Cookie banners are ugly and annoying. Fathom doesn’t use cookies, so no consent banner is required for your analytics. Learn how we protect visitor privacy .
yoursite.com
We value your privacy We use cookies to improve your experience, personalise content and analyse our traffic.
Customise Reject all Accept all
Fathom doesn’t use cookies.
Send email reports
Send yourself, your customers, or your coworkers email reports for one site or several, so anyone can keep track of your analytics without logging in.
Unlimited data retention
We keep your analytics history for as long as you’re a customer. View or export your data from the day you started using Fathom until right now, even if that’s 30 years of data.
A lightweight script for a fast website
Your analytics shouldn’t weigh down your website. Fathom’s lightweight script helps keep pages fast while you learn what’s working. Compare Fathom with Google Analytics .
Add it to your site’s <head> and you’re done <script
src="https://cdn.usefathom.com/script.js"
data-site="ABCDEFG"
defer></script>
Trusted by 1,000,000+ websites and counting
What kind of companies use Fathom? Fortune 100s, pioneers of the Open Web, Premier League football clubs, banks, and governments around the world all use our software to provide them with a privacy-focused and easy-to-use alternative to Google Analytics. Not to mention loads of small and mighty companies are Fathom customers as well.
I switched to Fathom because it's an ethical analytics tool that I trust . It gives me everything I want to know about my site's performance.
Charli Marie, Creative director of ConvertKit Our new Vue.js website has been using Fathom because I like how it's lightweight and respects user privacy.
Evan You, creator of Vue.js Fathom is a beautiful, fast piece of software built on Laravel and it lets us see what we need right away.
James Brooks, Head of Enterprise Enablement at Laravel I value my time and my website visitors right to privacy . That's why I've switched to Fathom Analytics.
Marshall Shorts, founder of Artfluential Fathom simplifies the task of analyzing site performance while simultaneously respecting my visitors' privacy. Also, it's a joy to use.
Jon Henshaw, founder of Coywolf Today, so many big tech corps are abusing our privacy. This is why I use Fathom. They're an analytics company I can trust .
Justin Jackson, Cofounder of Transistor Privacy-protections aside, I love the beautifully simple interface. Fathom is now part of my default stack.
Derrick Reimer, founder of SavvyCal They are the best Google Analytics alternative who really care about privacy and simplicity. Fathom's simple dashboard with clear metrics makes it easy to understand what's happening across all web properties.
Jessica Joyce, SEO expert Fathom Analytics is a great Google Analytics alternative because it is focused on protecting visitors' privacy and does not bog down loading times, leading to faster websites .
Nathalie Lussier, founder of AccessAlly.com After switching to Fathom for my web properties, I find I'm more attentive to my sites because I'm always aware of how many people are on them and which pages are most popular.
Caleb Porzio, creator of Alpine.js Getting started with Fathom is easy
You'll be looking at real numbers in a few minutes, without spying on anyone. And if you get stuck, our support team is always on hand to help you get up and running.
Step 1 Sign up for an account
Start with a 7-day free trial, then pricing starts at $15/month.
Step 2 Add our script
It's a single line of code that works with every site, web app and CMS. You can run it alongside your current analytics while you try Fathom.
Step 3 See your stats
Your Fathom dashboard will start showing you real-time data. Moving from Google Analytics? You can bring your GA4 history with you .
Fathom integrates easily with all content management systems and developer frameworks
We built Fathom from the very start to be privacy-focused and easy to use. Our business model is honest yet unusual for the startup scene: we charge a fair price for our software (instead of giving it away for free, then selling your data to generate revenue).
Our customers come first because they're our only investors. We don't have venture capital funding, bank loans, or other shareholders we answer to. Instead, we're happily independent and bootstrapped.
We grow sustainably when our customers tell their friends about Fathom, agencies start using us for all their client websites, or when reviewers try several analytics products and end up choosing us. This is the way we like it.
By supporting a company like ours, you are taking a step towards a shared vision of the internet that aligns with ours: away from the watchful eyes of big tech, based on trust and privacy, and all without compromising reliability, speed or quality of support.
Fathom began as an idea that a tech company could be run and grow while staying true to its values. It started as an analytics product that could be privacy-focused and simple without losing the value of its data.
We're proud of how we run our business, sell our product and serve our customers. And of course, we hope you'll join us.
Jack Ellis ,
founder of Fathom
Frequently asked questions
Can I use the same plan for multiple websites? Yes. Sites on a plan share your monthly pageviews. The larger pageview plans include more sites, and you can add extra site packs from billing if you need them.
How long do you store my analytics data? Forever, as long as you are a customer. You can access your data all the way back to when you signed up. 7 days, or even 30 days, doesn't show you if your site is trending up or down, which is why we keep your analytics history. Export it before you cancel if you leave.
Why is Fathom better than European-only providers? Our data isolation routes EU visitor traffic through EU infrastructure. Visitors elsewhere are routed through our global infrastructure, so they can connect closer to home. This helps keep analytics fast for visitors around the world.
What happens if I go over my pageview limit? We never charge for occasional traffic spikes, and we don't shut your account off if you hit your plan limit early. If you stay well over your limit, we'll email you about a larger plan, and you choose whether to upgrade. We send a few friendly reminders and extra time before we pause dashboard and API access, and we keep collecting your data throughout. See our plan-limits guide for the details.
Why isn't Fathom free like Google Analytics? If you aren't paying for a product, you are the product . That's why Google Analytics is free, because they make enough money off the personal data their customers give them by using their analytics service. We charge a small and sustainable fee for Fathom because our business model is selling software, not data. Our customers gladly pay for our service because they know their data is safe with us and their visitors' privacy is protected.
Why does digital privacy even matter? You may think that digital privacy doesn't matter because you have nothing to hide. And that may be true (to some extent), but your data shouldn't be monetised and sold by giant tech companies who are taking your tastes and preferences and selling them to advertisers. By using Fathom, you are making your website a black hole to big tech , meaning they cannot track any data about individuals who visit your website.

Frequently asked questions
How does the 7-day trial work? Choose a plan and add your card to start a 7-day free trial. Your card is not charged until the trial ends, and we’ll email you before your plan starts billing. Your subscription then renews automatically unless you cancel in your account settings. You can run Fathom alongside your existing analytics while you try it.
How do I cancel my account or trial? We’re not interested in having someone’s money if they aren’t happy. You can cancel anytime, right from your account settings. You don’t have to call or email us (unless you have a question). There are no contracts, and you can export your data before cancelling.
What happens if I hit my pageview limit? We’ll never turn your analytics off for occasional traffic spikes. If you stay well over your limit, we’ll email you about a larger plan, and you decide whether to upgrade or cancel (no hard feelings either way). We send a few friendly reminders and extra time before we pause dashboard and API access, and we keep collecting your data throughout. See our plan-limits guide for the details.
Do custom events count towards my pageview limit? Yes. If you use custom events on your website or send them through our API, each one counts towards your monthly pageview allowance.
How many sites does my plan include? Every plan includes at least 50 sites, and bigger plans include more. Select a plan above to see exactly how many. If you need more, you can add up to 15 packs of 50 extra sites yourself from your billing settings, at $10/month or $100/year per pack. Need to go really big? Get in touch and we’ll sort you out.
Can I change my pageview limit? Of course! If you exceed your limit for two months in a row, we’ll get in touch about a larger plan. Or, if you’re under your current tier for two months in a row (and it’s not our lowest tier already), you can move to a smaller plan from your billing settings.
Can I explore Fathom before signing up? We don’t do sales calls or live demos, but our software is ridiculously easy to use. You can watch our 10-minute walkthrough , click around the live dashboard or give Fathom a 7-day free trial alongside your existing analytics. Every feature is documented , and if you have specific questions, we’re here by email .
Do you offer a free plan? Nope, and here’s why: we’ve invested heavily in fast, reliable infrastructure (we don’t host Fathom on cheap servers that go offline). Our business model is selling software, not your data, so we’ve priced Fathom to be sustainable for a very long time.
Have another question? Reach out ! We’re happy to help with any pre-sales questions.

A Google Analytics alternative that’s privacy-focused and cookie-free
Fathom helps you understand your website visitors without spying on them. That’s why thousands of companies, from bootstrapped software companies to Fortune 100s, trust Fathom for their website analytics.
Don’t clutter your website with cookie banners
You don’t need a consent banner that annoys visitors, clutters your layout and slows the page down. Fathom doesn’t use cookies , so you can keep analytics on your site without the pop-up.
Protect the privacy of your website visitors
We’re GDPR, ePrivacy, PECR and CCPA compliant because digital privacy sits at the core of the product. We’ve had privacy lawyers vet how we collect and store data, and EU visitor data is processed in the EU automatically.
Read about data isolation
See humans, not bots
We filter out bots, crawlers, DDoS junk and other non-human traffic, so your dashboard is a picture of people who actually visited. Data shows up in real time, not 24 to 48 hours later.
Get the information you need to make decisions
See which pages are popular, who’s sending traffic, which campaigns are converting and which events are paying off, all from one dashboard. Add a filter and you can drill into a campaign, a country or a single page in a click.
Learn how our dashboard works
Start free trial View a live demo 7-day free trial No cookie notices required GDPR compliant More of what you can do with Fathom
Save the filters you use every week
Want to check your blog traffic, a campaign or visitors from a particular country? Combine filters, give the view a name and open it again in one click. Everyone with access to that site can use the same saved views.
Saved views
Put your traffic changes in context
Mark a launch, a redesign or a press mention on your chart with a milestone. Compare dates to see how traffic changed from the previous week, month or year, or choose your own periods.
Milestones Date comparisons
Track signups, sales and their value
Record newsletter signups, form submissions and purchases as events. Send a value with a purchase and choose the currency for your events, so you can see sales totals alongside completion counts.
Event tracking
See which campaigns bring people to your site
Use UTM tags to tell your newsletters, ads and social campaigns apart. Filter the dashboard by a campaign to see its traffic, the pages people visited and the events they completed.
UTM tracking
Send reports to your clients automatically
Schedule weekly or monthly emails for yourself, colleagues or clients. Send a report for one website, or bring several sites together in the same email. Each recipient gets the sites you select.
Email reports
Look after all your websites in one place
Every plan includes at least 50 sites, with extra packs available. Check them together in the all-sites view, then open a site for the details. Share individual dashboards publicly or protect them with a password.
All-sites view Dashboard sharing
Use your data outside the dashboard
Download CSV files for a spreadsheet or report, or use our API to bring Fathom data into your own tools. Your analytics should be useful wherever you work.
CSV exports API documentation
Bring Google Analytics and Search Console with you
Import historical GA4 data, and connect Google Search Console to see search terms, clicks, impressions and search positions alongside your website analytics.
GA importer Search Console
Add Fathom to the tools you already use
Use Fathom with WordPress, Ghost, Webflow, Next.js, Nuxt and plenty more. Add one line of JavaScript, or use one of our integrations if you’d rather not touch templates.
Browse integrations
Keep your pages light
Our small script loads asynchronously, so it doesn’t hold up the rest of your page. You can measure your traffic without adding a bulky analytics script.
Install the script
Keep your history
Every plan includes ongoing data retention. Come back to an old campaign, compare this year with last year, or see how far your site has come since you first installed Fathom.
Account questions
Infrastructure that keeps up when you go viral
A launch or a popular post can bring a lot of visitors at once. Fathom is built to handle traffic spikes and large websites, so you can keep an eye on what’s happening.
Analytics for high-traffic sites
Start free trial View a live demo 7-day free trial No cookie notices required GDPR compliant Have something specific in mind?
Our help centre covers the details, including multi-domain tracking , excluding your own traffic and more. If you’re not sure whether Fathom fits what you need, ask us .
Frequently asked questions about Fathom
Does Fathom Analytics use cookies? No. That’s why you don’t need a consent banner for analytics. You can read more about how we process data on our data journey page .
Is Fathom Analytics GDPR compliant? Yes. Privacy law comes before features we could otherwise build. You can read more about our GDPR-compliant website analytics .
What is Fathom doing with my data? We’re open about how data is processed and stored. Our anonymisation methods are documented, and EU visitor data is handled with data isolation .
Can I host the data locally? No. Fathom is a hosted product so we can process pageviews on a global CDN, keep dashboards fast, and process EU visitor data in the EU. Everyone else is routed to the closest region.
Who owns my data? You do. We sell software, not data. Other analytics products can afford to be “free” because they profit from what they collect about your visitors.
How do I opt out of being counted? Fathom doesn’t track individuals. We anonymise data with hashes and salts . If you still don’t want your own visits on a dashboard, block your IP or run a small script from your browser console. You can also set Fathom to honour DNT .
Do you support goal tracking? Yes. They’re called events , and you can use them for newsletter signups, link clicks or ecommerce sales.
Can I import Google Analytics into Fathom? Yes. Our GA importer brings GA4 data into Fathom so you can keep the history after Google deletes it. The import is done in a privacy-focused way.
Can I connect Google Search Console? Yes. Link your site and you’ll see search terms, countries, devices and pages alongside your analytics. Here’s how to set it up .

How to set up and use Fathom Analytics
Fathom is a simple, privacy-first Google Analytics alternative. You get one page of useful data, not thousands of reports to hunt through.
Let’s walk through setup from the script to your first email report.
Start free trial View a live demo 7-day free trial No cookie notices required GDPR compliant
Step 1 Add the script
One line of code, or an integration if you’d rather not touch templates.
Step 2 Your dashboard
Pages, referrers, events, campaigns and live visitors, all on one screen.
Step 3 Email reports
A weekly or monthly snapshot in your inbox, for one site or many.
Add our script to your site
To collect data from a site, blog, store or web app, add one line of JavaScript to your header. That’s the whole install.
You can paste it in yourself , use our WordPress plugin , or pick another integration if you’d rather not touch templates.
Your site’s head <script
src="https://cdn.usefathom.com/script.js"
data-site="YOUR-SITE-ID"
defer>
</script>
Use the snippet from your site settings, not this example. Replace YOUR-SITE-ID with your real Site ID. Additional features you can set up here
Block your own visits
Keep your refreshes off the dashboard with IP blocking or a snippet in your console .
No cookie banner needed
Fathom doesn’t use cookies , so you don’t need a consent pop-up for analytics. Read how we stay GDPR compliant , or see what your current setup adds with our cookie checker .
At least 50 sites on every plan
Add sites for yourself or your clients . Need more? Extra packs of 50 are $10/month.
Works with your stack
WordPress, Ghost, Webflow, Next.js and plenty more. If we don’t have a plugin, the same snippet still works .

Keep EU visitors’ personal data in the EU
Lots of analytics software claims to comply with various privacy laws, such as GDPR, PECR or the ePrivacy Directive, but most of them are putting you and your website visitors at risk.
Data Isolation was built in collaboration with EU legal experts, and is part of our commitment to simplify your compliance.
EU visitors’ personal data stays in the EU. Anonymized analytics are stored on our US infrastructure. Privacy laws will keep changing, and we want to process data in the country it belongs. The EU and the US are the two biggest markets for that today. This feature exists for all customers on all plans and happens without any programming or setup required.
Here’s why Fathom is your best option for GDPR compliance
No other analytics software goes to the measures we do to comply with GDPR, and do it in a way that doesn’t hurt your SEO or page speed load times.
Google Analytics Other analytics Fathom
Protects visitor personal data No Sometimes Yes
Anonymises visitor logs No Sometimes Yes
Processes EU traffic in the EU No Sometimes Yes
Processes US traffic in the US Yes Yes Yes
Start free trial View a live demo 7-day free trial No cookie notices required GDPR compliant
Why data isolation matters
It doesn’t matter if an analytics company is located in the EU. What matters more is how and where they process data and whether EU visitor IP addresses reach US-servers.
If you’re a company in the EU , all of your EU traffic is processed on our EU servers, located within EU borders, ensuring your visitors' IP addresses never reach US infrastructure.
If you’re a company outside the EU , then you still will no doubt have visitors from the EU. Fathom takes care of routing all your EU visitors to EU-servers for you, automatically.
Since Fathom is a Canadian corporation (eh), we’ve implemented strict Data Isolation, allowing you to comply with GDPR while ensuring EU visitor IP addresses never reach US-servers.
Data Isolation means intelligently routing your visitors
Fathom’s Data Isolation method works by intelligently routing visitors to the right place to process their data. When we say “data,” we’re talking about the user’s IP address, which, along with a User-Agent, could be used to potentially identify an individual in the EU, making it “personal data.”
If a visitor is outside the EU , our EU-owned CDN (Bunny.net) sends their pageview to our US servers directly and anonymizes their "data" (IP address).
If a visitor is inside the EU , our CDN sends their pageview to our European servers and anonymizes their data immediately. The IP address (personal data under GDPR) is stripped from the request inside of the EU and never reaches our US infrastructure. The anonymous data is then stored on our main US servers for fast and easy retrieval on our customer dashboards, but there’s zero personal data associated with any of it.
In all scenarios, Fathom fully protects the privacy of every website visitor’s personal information.
You can read more about our data journey and compliance practices .
Join thousands of companies already using Fathom Analytics
Frequently asked questions (and answers)
How fast and reliable is your EU infrastructure? Our EU Cloud is monitored 24/7, highly available, multi-region and has enough capacity to process Bieber-level traffic. And, as usual, this feature is available to all customers on all plans.
How do I enable Data Isolation? If you’re a Fathom customer, then congratulations, you’re already using Data Isolation and complying with privacy laws! We enable this by default for everyone on every plan.
Is Data Isolation available to me on my current plan? Yes. Every plan includes Data Isolation, including the smallest. It’s enabled by default.
Why process and anonymize an IP address in the first place? Whenever you visit a website, your IP address and User-Agent are sent to that website's servers (that's just how the internet works). Some websites retain raw logs of that information, keeping tabs on what you're browsing. Whilst others (i.e Fathom Analytics) guarantee that your visit is anonymized and not used against you. You can read more about this on our data journey .
